source.snippet: Tell HN: ChatGPT and Codex usage will be combined. Email text: 'In the coming weeks, you'll be able to delegate work directly to ChatGPT — from building sites and presentations to taking action on the web — without switching to the Work tab... A shared allowance for ChatGPT and Codex. As part of this unified experience, your use of ChatGPT and Codex will draw from [a shared pool].' Comments thread active with 3 replies, 6 points.

problem_statement: Professional teams using both ChatGPT and Codex face unexpected usage consolidation that collapses separate budgets/allowances into a shared pool, disrupting workflows and spend planning without warning or granular controls.
target_segment: Engineering managers and CTOs at SMBs and agencies paying for ChatGPT Plus/Team and Codex API access who need predictable per-product budget allocation.
notes: Buyer signal: paying subscribers to ChatGPT Team/Enterprise and Codex API. The forced merge of allowances is a recurring cost-management pain point. Opportunity: a spend-tracking and alerting layer that sits atop OpenAI usage APIs and gives teams per-product budget visibility, warnings, and caps before overages hit. Low signal count but commercial context is strong.
